EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Sorry we missed you on our Product Insights Open Forum earlier this week! Our product managers highlighted updates to our education solutions as well as an overview and demo of our new Third-Party Invoicing solution.
Here is a copy of the slideshow presentation <[[https://assets.flywire.com/collateral/education/clients/Flywire-Product-Insights-Open-Forum-June-2024.pdf]]>, and you can access the webinar recording here <[[https://flywire.zoom.us/rec/play/JEgWeSbAKVWIvUQyYvHaYc7AExYkzV7wt7omwfq3JVzQt7M_lQfDyU1Xz_1tcC_kGnA0Wwxm1uWAnto8.TpTt9nYQY5cY2qJU]]> by entering your unique passcode: FW555987!
If you have any questions or would like to learn more about any of our education solutions, please reach out to your Relationship Manager or reply to this email <[[mailto:learnmore@flywire.com]]>.
Thank you! The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
